description: Agent Insurance: submit a certificate of insurance with the policy it was issued from: the certificate with the date it was issued, the insurer, the policy number, the named insured, its currency, the per-occurrence and aggregate limits and the dates it shows, the additional insureds it names, whether it states a waiver of subrogation and the certificate holder; the policy with its insurer, number, named insured, currency, limits and dates, and each endorsement with its id, its kind (additional insured, waiver of subrogation, primary and noncontributory or other) and the parties it names (a blanket endorsement when left out); and optionally the holder’s requirements with the holder’s name, whether the holder must be an additional insured, whether a waiver of subrogation is required and the per-occurrence and aggregate minimums. The signed report gives the certificate, the policy, the named insured, insurer and policy number on each side, every limit with the certificate beside the policy, the certificate’s dates against the policy period, every additional insured and the waiver with the endorsement that backs it or none, and every holder requirement with whether it is met, and counts them, and names a mismatched certificate: a named insured, insurer or policy number that differs from the policy, limits above the policy’s, dates past the policy period, and an additional insured or a waiver of subrogation that no endorsement on the policy carries; then limits or dates shown narrower than the policy’s, holder requirements left unmet and limits in another currency, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No named insured on either side, no limit on both sides, no policy period on either side, or no endorsements where the certificate claims an additional insured or waiver leaves the certificate unverified. This reads one certificate against the policy it was issued from: a counterparty’s certificate read as diligence evidence against your required coverages, limits and work window is wever_insurance-evidence-check, certification or license claims against evidence are wever_certification-evidence-check and a counterparty onboarding packet’s completeness is wever_counterparty-onboarding-check. Verdict insurance_certificate_mismatched, insurance_certificate_partial, insurance_certificate_unverified or insurance_certificate_matching. POST /api/insurance-certificate-check. Reads the insurance records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, claim filing, coverage binding or external write. Agent Insurance reads an insurance policy after the fact, from the subject’s own records: the coverage against the insured activity, the exclusions against the activity and its parts, the limits against the stated exposure, the deductible against what the buyer was told, the claims deadlines against an incident, a certificate against the policy it was issued from, incident notice under the policy and a renewal against the expiring policy. Beside it, wever_insurance-evidence-check reads a counterparty’s insurance certificate or policy excerpt as diligence evidence and reports what that material establishes against required coverages, limits and a work window, while an insurance check reads the subject’s own policy against a stated need, an incident or a certificate issued from it; wever_warranty-check reads a warranty claim against warranty terms, while an insurance check reads an insurance policy; and wever_risk-downside-check reads a planned action’s downside before it is taken, while an insurance check reads the policy behind it after the fact. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-insurance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-insurance/.
